description: Answers a question about SarnAI's products (the Agent Discovery Board, the Agent Output Verifier, AI Agent Scores) by quoting their published documents verbatim, each passage with its source, section and link; no model writes anything. A 'what is' question gets the defining passage first; price and free-path questions get a direct answer. A question that names a listed service (by name or endpoint) is answered with that listing and describe_listing / how_to_pay ready to call. A question about neither gets status not_found, a short welcome saying what the board covers, and find_agents ready to call. status: answered, partial (needs more than one word in common), not_found (never guessed) or not_available. Deterministic. Free, no payment or account required.

agent_id.description: Optional label for yourself (usage statistics only).

product.description: Search only the documents of one product. Omit to search them all.

question.description: A question about the Agent Discovery Board, the Agent Output Verifier, AI Agent Scores or a listed service (by name or endpoint), in plain words.

trace_id.description: trace_id from a previous response, to continue a conversation; omit on the first call.

name: ask_sarnai
title: Ask about SarnAI's products
